$comment: Axolotl form-quirks catalog. The taxonomy of real form systems/quirks a school-bureaucracy agent will hit, with concrete examples from big urban districts (NYC/SF/Chicago) plus the benchmark tiers. Each entry: the form system, the quirk, the capability it exercises, and how we handle it. This shapes the roadmap of what to harden next.

capabilityStatus.browser_form_fill: proven (Google Form + basic HTML + form.io radios/checkboxes/selects)

quirks.quirk: SSO/login/account-creation + OTP, then a multi-step application wizard. Session-bound.
quirks.exercises: account hand (signup/login/OTP), session persistence, multi-step fill
quirks.status: hand proven on Go Kids; each portal is bespoke
quirks.notes: GoCPS: 'log in to the GoCPS portal', application windows (Sept 9 - Nov 13). Non-CPS students must sign up for testing via the app.

quirks.quirk: Multi-step, account-gated, many categorical-eligibility questions (like Go Kids step 1 scaled up).
quirks.status: reached + language-select; full wizard not yet filled
quirks.notes: BenefitsCal starts with a language selector; the wizard is account-gated.

quirks.quirk: Web enrollment form tied to a Student Information System (Aeries/SIS). Account/session tied to an existing SIS record; multi-step; data pre-populated from the SIS.
quirks.notes: Aeries is among the most common K-12 enrollment SaaS; the form reflects the district's SIS schema.

quirks.system: JotForm / Google Forms / Microsoft Forms embedded on district sites
quirks.quirk: Third-party builder widgets (JotForm custom components, Google Forms role=radio, MS Forms), variable label access, CAPTCHA on some.
quirks.status: Google Forms proven; JotForm/MS Forms untested
quirks.notes: JotForm wraps fields in custom widgets; may need selector/vision escalation.

quirks.quirk: AcroForm fields; garbled names / broken ToUnicode; scanned (image) PDFs need OCR.
quirks.notes: Scan/form.pdf need a per-form map; delivery = email attachment (unwired).

quirks.system: Facebook Forms embedded on org sites (SPINSC, Encompass)
quirks.quirk: Controlled inputs that reject fill(); bot detection. Anti-automation tech.
quirks.status: reached + 4/5 fill; controlled fields don't persist
quirks.notes: Needs raw keystrokes (page.keyboard / pressSequentially), which Stagehand's wrapper hides. Treat as 'guide the parent'.

quirks.system: reCAPTCHA / hCaptcha on many contact + enrollment forms
quirks.notes: Never try to bypass — hand off the link and explain.

quirks.system: Proof-of-residence, I-9, immunization, income docs on enrollment/pdfs/portals
quirks.quirk: File-upload widget (multi-file, drag-drop), often on account-gated portals or PDF portals.
quirks.notes: Needs a browserFillFile primitive (Stagehand could setInputFiles).

quirks.quirk: Labels in another language + garbled encodings; need label mapping + locale.
quirks.status: proven (Capitola field map; Spanish locale fix)
quirks.notes: detectLocale now conservative (only unambiguous Spanish triggers).

nyc.enroll: NYC DOE 3-K/Pre-K via ACCESS NYC (benefits portal)

roadmap: 1. Account portals (GoCPS/NYCSA/SFUSD): reuse the account hand + multi-step fill; add session persistence (Browserbase sessionId).
2. SIS-integrated (Aeries): test a real Aeries enrollment; handle SIS-linked auth + pre-populated fields.
3. JotForm/MS Forms: test + harden the builder widgets (selector/vision escalation).
4. File upload: add a browserFillFile primitive (setInputFiles) for document uploads.
5. Raw keystrokes for FB/hard forms: expose a typing path (Playwright keyboard) for controlled inputs.
6. PDF delivery: wire filled PDF into the email step (needs email backend).
